commentary_title: Aframax market remains weak but has scope for improvement
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index ended the week at 94.6 points, recovering for the first time after declining continuously for three consecutive weeks. It was a slow week as rates fell on most routes, especially in the Med and UKC regions. There was some activity right towards the weekend, however, prospects for an improvement in market activity next week remain bleak. | Due to China's demand remaining weak and demand towards West Coast India being stable, the market activity towards the East remained on the softer side. Meanwhile, towards the West, bad weather conditions in the North Sea could hamper trade in the region but might help support rates. Overall, freight rates are likely to remain soft next week, but an improvement in oil demand could see fewer ballast vessels especially towards the West.
